suggestion: Make opening and closing snapshots immutable append-only observations
decision_impact: Preserves CLV measurement and prevents retrospective quote edits
tradeoff: Requires reliable capture service and timestamp provenance
recommended_path: Adopt the schema in store.py and require source URL plus UTC capture time

suggestion: Use explicit market and selection IDs across origination quotes and results
decision_impact: Enables deterministic joins and avoids matching by team-name text
tradeoff: Requires a stable ID policy before multiple markets are ingested
recommended_path: Adopt event_id, market_id and selection_id as mandatory keys

suggestion: Keep official game results separate from operator ticket settlement
decision_impact: Prevents assuming league box score alone resolves every wager
tradeoff: Requires jurisdiction-specific rules and additional source checks
recommended_path: Store league outcomes and sportsbook settlement records as separate tables

suggestion: Require jurisdiction-specific rule-profile version on each settled bet
decision_impact: Reduces incorrect treatment of pushes, postponements, overtime and player props
recommended_path: Block ROI until applicable rule URL and jurisdiction are present

suggestion: Ingest authorized timestamped market history instead of estimating open/close
decision_impact: Allows defensible price movement and closing-line analysis
tradeoff: May require licensed vendor and retention costs
recommended_path: Compare official operator feeds/API contracts and terms before selecting a provider

suggestion: Publish signal metrics separately from staking returns
decision_impact: Separates predictive quality from bet sizing variance
tradeoff: Needs probability forecasts and a locked evaluation plan
recommended_path: Rank calibration, Brier/log loss separately from ROI and staking policy

suggestion: Use walk-forward and multiple-testing corrections before leaderboard rewards
tradeoff: Needs enough independent seasons and a pre-registered trial count
recommended_path: Require holdout gates and publish sample size and uncertainty

suggestion: Add replacement depth and role to injury adjustments only from team charts plus official availability
decision_impact: Distinguishes a first-string absence from a fourth-string replacement
tradeoff: Official depth-chart completeness and time-sensitive snapshots vary
recommended_path: Preserve depth-chart retrieval time and blank unsupported role/impact values
